name: BACH_0174_FSIM_stain3
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (100%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class set, high reliability, second model agrees [F1].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
|---|---|---|
| Top probabilities | Invasive 100%, InSitu 0% | Near-certain |
| Conformal set | Invasive only | Single class |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.996, 64th percentile | Typical input |
| Second-model (MUSK) agreement | Same top class | Agrees |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive [F5] | Mostly agree |

## Tissue evidence
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 10, 11) · ↓ invasive · Above typical; linked to lower invasive likelihood [F4] · Weak
- **Tumor infiltrating stroma** (region 0) · ↑ invasive · Above typical; linked to invasive carcinoma · Validated
- **Atypical cells confined within ducts** (region 11) · ↑ invasive · Below typical; mixed spot check · Weak
- **Normal lobules** (region 9) · ↑ invasive · Low score read as invasive-leaning; spot check 0/20 [F2] · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Top-3 deletion drops the invasive logit 0.54 more than random (CI 0.47–0.60); faithful to the classifier.
- **Concepts**: Deletion test equals random (+0.002, CI −0.005 to 0.007); not validated. Leans on Unreliable normal lobules (0/20) and Weak TILs (8/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Simulated stain degradation (severity 3); reliability ranks errors only modestly (AUROC 0.69).
- Gland-rich regions 3, 10, 11 are benign or in situ; neighbor BACH_0241 is InSitu.

## Check on the slide
1. **9, 0, 8** Highest heatmap contribution; confirm invasive carcinoma.
2. **3, 10, 11** Tubule-like, lower region risk (49%, 44%, 76%); confirm benign versus tumor glands.
3. **0, 3, 8, 11** Corner regions; confirm tumor at the cut edge [F7].
